messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["horse", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A four-legged animal with the overall body shape, head, and stance of a horse standing in three-quarter profile facing right. Its head, ears, muzzle, and hooved lower legs are brown and horse-like, while the top of its head, neck, back, sides, outer surfaces of all four legs, and long tapering tail are densely covered in overlapping brown scales. The underside of the torso, chest, and inner upper legs show pale tan shaggy fur. It stands on a small patch of dirt with sparse grass.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown horse head with long muzzle, dark eye, large nostril and mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front end of the neck, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "two upright pointed brown horse ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "four long slender horse-like legs with pale fur on the inner upper portions", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "dark brown rounded horse hooves with a fringe of brown hair above", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long narrow tapering tail fully covered in small overlapping scales", "part": "tail", "where": "hanging down from the rear of the body on the left side"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown pangolin-like scales in rows, smaller on the head and lower legs and larger on the neck, body and upper legs", "part": "scales", "where": "covering the top of the head, the entire neck, back, sides, outer legs, and tail"}, {"looks_like": "pale cream to light tan shaggy fur", "part": "underbelly fur", "where": "on the underside of the torso, lower chest, and inner upper legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
